seo.title: Custom Software, Websites, Automation & AI | LASAN MARINE
seo.description: Custom management systems, websites, workflow automation and AI-enabled applications built around real workflows, data and operational needs.

fields.headline: Maritime engineering software, web apps and AI agents
fields.lead: We are a ship-design firm that writes software, so we understand the work before we write code. We build websites and custom web apps, integrate AI agents, and take on demanding engineering software that general outsourcing teams cannot grasp the domain of.

fields.heading: Why a team that knows the domain

items.title: We know ship design and engineering
items.desc: Our engineers design vessels and use the tools they build every day — we speak your engineers’ language.

items.title: We take on hard problems
items.desc: Hydrostatics, stability, resistance, 3D model processing, automated drawings and reports — work that needs both domain knowledge and programming.

items.title: Proven in our own work first
items.desc: Many tools are developed and tested on our own design projects before they are packaged for clients.

fields.heading: From real work to software
fields.intro: A lot of engineering and operational work still runs on spreadsheets, scattered documents, repetitive steps or data held in many places. When these problems come up in our work, we look at how to standardise the process and build the right tool.

input.text: Documents that are hard to use

items.problem: My data is spread across many files
items.context: When information sits in Excel, Word, shared folders or separate systems, we can build one central system to enter, find, update and control it.

items.problem: A task has to be done over and over
items.context: Data entry, calculations, forms, reports or data hand-offs can be standardised and automated.

items.problem: I need software built around our own process
items.context: We analyse the current process and identifies the data, users and steps before designing the system.

items.problem: I want to use AI but don't know where
items.context: We look at the data and process first to decide whether AI is really needed, then chooses the right way to apply it.

steps.title: Understand the current work
steps.desc: Identify the users, data, steps and the problem to solve.

steps.title: Define the requirements
steps.desc: Agree the scope, functions, data and expected results.

steps.title: Build and test
steps.desc: Develop in parts that can be checked and used early.

steps.title: Deploy and refine
steps.desc: Put it into real use, handle feedback and refine how it is used.

fields.caption: Digital solutions
fields.heading: Deliverables can include
fields.body: Scope, infrastructure, integration and handover are agreed per project. Technology is chosen to fit the system requirements and the deployment environment.

items.text: Software or tools within the agreed scope
Integration with other systems where needed

fields.heading: Is there a task you want to make simpler?
fields.description: Describe the current process, the data you use and the part that takes too much time. We will look at whether software or automation is the right fit.
